# Conditions excluding noTcells
conditions = ['Acute Tcells S1', 'Acute Tcells S2', 'Chronic Round1 S1', 'Chronic Round1 S2', 'Chronic Round2 S1', 'Chronic Round2 S2', 'Chronic Round3 S1', 'Chronic Round3 S2']

# For each gene, take min p-value across its RefSeqs
gene_pvals = pv.groupby('symbol')[conditions].min()
print('Gene-level shape:', gene_pvals.shape)

background = set(gene_pvals.index)
print('Background size:', len(background))

# Filter pathways to those with overlap with background
pathways_filt = {n: g & background for n, g in pathways.items()}
pathways_filt = {n: g for n, g in pathways_filt.items() if len(g) >= 5}
print('Filtered pathways:', len(pathways_filt))

N = len(background)

results_summary = {}
for cond in conditions:
    sig_genes = set(gene_pvals.index[gene_pvals[cond] < 0.05])

"""

      significant enrichment (adjusted p-value < 0.05) of immune-relevant pathways.

import pandas as pd

import gseapy as gp

enr = pd.read_excel(xlsx, sheet_name='sgRNA enrichment')

# RefSeq -> Symbol mapping (precomputed via mygene)
map_df = pd.read_csv('refseq_symbol_map.csv')
map_df = map_df[~map_df['symbol'].isna()]
refseq2sym = dict(zip(map_df['query'], map_df['symbol']))

pv['symbol'] = pv['RefSeq ID'].map(refseq2sym); pv = pv[~pv['symbol'].isna()]
enr['symbol'] = enr['RefSeq ID'].map(refseq2sym); enr = enr[~enr['symbol'].isna()]

# === Load Reactome pathways ===
pathways = {}
with open('ReactomePathways.gmt') as f:
    for line in f:
        parts = line.strip().split('\t')
        pathways[parts[0]] = parts[2:]

# Identify immune-relevant pathways
immune_kw = ['immune', 'interferon', 'cytokine', 'interleukin', 'antigen', 'mhc',
             't cell', 't-cell', 'tcr', 'nfkb', 'nf-kb', 'tnf', 'inflammat',
             'jak-stat', 'jak/stat', 'innate', 'adaptive', 'chemokine',
             'lymphocyte', 'leukocyte', 'complement']

    'Chronic Round2': ['Chronic Round2 S1', 'Chronic Round2 S2'],
    'Chronic Round3': ['Chronic Round3 S1', 'Chronic Round3 S2'],
}

                 'Chronic Round2 S1','Chronic Round2 S2','Chronic Round3 S1','Chronic Round3 S2']

n_with_immune = sum(1 for t,i in summary.values() if i > 0)
n_total = len(bio_conds)
pct = 100 * n_with_immune / n_total
print(f'\nConditions with significant immune enrichment: {n_with_immune}/{n_total}')
print(f'Percentage: {pct:.1f}%')
